Recipe.name: Crinkle French Fries
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1, Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. 2. Fry frozen potatoes until golden brown and crisp, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain. FOR ONE SERVING: 1. on specified serving dish, place 3 ozw fries. 2. Serve immediately.
Recipe.special_instructions: Place fryer basket on sheet pan to fill. DO NOT fill basket over fryer. DO NOT fill fryer basket more than 1/3 full.

Recipe.name: Dill Pickle Slices
Recipe.special_instructions: chopped 1/4" 1 tbl = 3/8 ozw 1-oz spoodle = 3/4 ozw 2-oz spoodle = 1 1/2 ozw 3-oz spoodle = 2 1/4 ozw 4-oz spoodle = 3 ozw 6-oz spoodle = 4 1/2 ozw 8-oz spoodle = 6 ozw IDDSI Level 7

Recipe.name: Buffalo Chicken Grilled Cheese
Recipe.assembly_instructions: FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on 1 slice of bread: 1 slice cheese 1 tbl Buffalo Blue Dressing 2-oz spoodle Chicken 1 slice cheese 2nd slice of bread 2. Brush outside of sandwich with 1 tbl margarine. PANINI PRESS METHOD 1. Preheat panini press to 400 F. 2. Place sandwich in panini press. Cook until sandwich is browned and cheese begins to melt, 3 to 4 minutes. Cheese does not have to melt completely. 3. Cut diagonally in half. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service. FLAT-TOP GRIDDLE METHOD 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. Cook sandwich, turning once, until browned and cheese is melted, 2 to 3 minutes on each side. 3. Cut diagonally in half. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Crispy Chicken BBQ Snacker
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. 2. Fry frozen chicken patties until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165 F, 4 to 6 minutes. Drain. 3. Cut each patty into 3 strips. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following in center of 1 tortilla: 2 tsp sauce 1-oz spoodle lettuce 1 piece onion, separated into rings 1 piece chicken 1 slice cheese Fold bottom of tortilla up over filling, about 1". Fold in right and left edges of tortilla 2" on each side to form a V. Top 1/3 of filling should be exposed. 2. Keep hot for service.
Recipe.special_instructions: Place fryer basket on sheet pan to fill. DO NOT fill basket over fryer. DO NOT fill fryer basket more than 1/3 full.

Recipe.name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion, celery and carrot. Saute until vegetables are tender, 4 to 6 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and base. 2. Add remaining ingredients except half & half and basil. Whisk until well blended. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 35 minutes. Discard bay leaves. Puree. 3. Heat half & half to 140 F. 4. Return pureed mixture to pot. Stir in heated half & half. Return to a simmer. DO NOT BOIL. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service. 6. At time of service, stir in basil.

Recipe.name: Nacho Grilled Cheese
Recipe.assembly_instructions: FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on 1 slice of bread: 1 slice cheese 2 slices tomato 1-oz spoodle chips 1 tbl jalapeno 2nd slice cheese 2nd slice of bread 2. Brush outside of sandwich with 1 tbl margarine. PANINI PRESS METHOD 1. Preheat panini press to 400 F. 2. Place sandwich in panini press. Cook until sandwich is browned and cheese begins to melt, 3 to 4 minutes. Cheese does not have to melt completely. 3. Cut diagonally in half. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service. FLAT-TOP GRIDDLE METHOD 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. Cook sandwich, turning once, until browned and cheese is melted, 2 to 3 minutes on each side. 3. Cut diagonally in half. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Crispy Chicken Sandwich
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. 2. Fry frozen chicken patties until internal temperature reaches 165 F, 4 to 5 minutes. Drain. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on bottom half of roll: 1 chicken patty Top half of roll 2. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Grilled Black Bean Burger
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat char-grill to medium or flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. Cook frozen burgers 4 minutes. Turn burgers over. Cook until internal temperature reaches 165 F, 4 to 5 minutes. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on bottom half of 1 roll: 1 burger Top half of roll 2. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Grilled Herb Chicken Sandwich
